welcome.title: Sideways hands
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Sideways hands
sections.intro: Windows at arm's length. Turn your hand on its side, thumb on top, as for a handshake, and pinch, drag and tap them that way. A hand on its edge is the hardest for the cameras to judge for distance. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand on its side, thumb on top, as for a handshake.|Pinch the lit part with the hand still on its side, hold until it goes out, then let go.

acts.say: On its side: pinch the lit part and hold

prompts.text: Right hand on its side. Pinch the lit bar and take it to the ghost: nearer, farther,|across. Then let go.

acts.say: On its side: pinch the bar, take it to the ghost

prompts.text: Left hand on its side, thumb on top. Pinch the lit part, hold until it goes out, then let go.

acts.say: On its side: pinch the lit part and hold

prompts.text: Left hand on its side. Pinch the lit bar and take it to the ghost, then let go.

acts.say: On its side: pinch the bar, take it to the ghost

prompts.text: A window at the end of your reach. Arm straight out, hand on its side:|pinch the lit part and hold.

acts.say: Arm straight, on its side: pinch and hold

prompts.text: Right hand on its side, pointing at the lit button: tap thumb to index, as a click.|Keep the hand on its side between taps.
Right hand open, on its edge, palm facing left. When the edge lights, sweep the hand|right to left, a quick stroke of about 30 cm, palm leading. Bring it back slowly.

acts.say: Sweep it left: a quick stroke, palm leading

prompts.text: Right hand on its side. Cyan: pinch it. Orange: bring thumb and index about 1 cm apart|and stop there, no pinch.
Your own pace: pinch the lit bar and move the window around, as often as you like.|Turn the hand between flat and on its side while you do.

acts.say: Your own pace: pinch it and move it
